text: What is the primary purpose of an HTML form on a web page?
choices: To collect user input and send it to a server
To format the layout of the page
explanation: A form in HTML is a container used to collect different kinds of inputs from the user... used to setup the account... or register on a website.

text: Which attribute of the `<form>` tag specifies the HTTP method used to send data?
explanation: The method attribute specifies the HTTP method to be used when sending the data.

text: What is the default value for the `method` attribute if it is not specified?
explanation: The default value for method attribute is GET.

text: Which HTTP method sends form data as part of the URL?
explanation: The GET method retrieves the data from the form and sends it to the server by attaching it at the end of the URL.

text: Which HTTP method sends data as a block within the HTTP transaction, keeping it hidden from the URL?
explanation: In the POST method, the data is sent as a block through the HTTP transaction.

text: What does the `action` attribute in the `<form>` tag specify?
choices: The filename/URL where data is sent
explanation: The action attribute is used to specify where to send the form data when the form is submitted. It takes a filename as value.

text: Which tag is used to create a multi-line text input field?
explanation: The Textarea element allows multi-line text input. The tag <textarea>...</textarea> is used to implement this element.

text: Which input type creates a field where characters are masked (e.g., as dots)?
explanation: Password: Creates a password field... the characters are not displayed to the user... converted into non readable format.

text: If you want a user to select only one option from a group, which input type should be used?
explanation: Radio: Creates radio buttons... Generally used to select a single item from a given group of items.

text: Which input type allows multiple selections from a group of options?
explanation: Checkbox: Creates checkboxes in the form. Multiple check boxes can be selected at a time.

text: What is KompoZer?
choices: A free open source web development IDE
explanation: KompoZer is a free open source web development IDE... used to create web pages.

text: What does WYSIWYG stand for?
choices: What You See Is What You Get
Where You See Is Where You Go
Who You See Is Who You Get
Why You See Is What You Get
explanation: It provides a web page editor which has a simple graphical interface known as WYSIWYG (What You See Is What You Get).

text: In KompoZer, which pane is used to navigate between files on your site?
explanation: Site manager is a powerful tool used to navigate within the site or between the sites.

text: Which tab in KompoZer displays the raw HTML code?
explanation: The Source tab shows all details of the HTML code.

text: Which tag creates a drop-down menu in an HTML form?
explanation: The select element is used to create a drop down list or menu in a form. The tag <select> is used.

text: Which tag defines the individual items within a drop-down menu?
explanation: The tag <option>...</option> is used to create the elements within the menu.

text: What does the `cols` attribute of a `<textarea>` tag control?
choices: The width (number of characters) of the text area
explanation: The cols attribute is used to set the number of columns of text that will be visible (width).

text: Which button in the KompoZer Composition Toolbar opens a new file?
explanation: To create a new file, open KompoZer. In the menu bar click File -> New (or use New icon).

text: How can you close the Site Manager pane in KompoZer?
explanation: You can close the site manager pane by clicking on close button or press F9.

text: Which view mode in KompoZer shows the page exactly as it would appear in a browser?
explanation: The Preview mode offers the page view as seen in a browser.

text: What color outline indicates a form has been inserted in KompoZer's Normal view?
explanation: You can see the form inserted with light blue colored outline in the untitled page.

text: Which menu option allows you to insert a label for a form field in KompoZer?
explanation: Click on Insert -> Form -> Define label.

text: Which button creates a form in KompoZer using the toolbar?
explanation: Alternatively, you can also click on 'Form' in the composition toolbar. This will open a Form Properties dialog box.

text: What does the `rows` attribute of a `<textarea>` tag specify?
choices: The width of the text area
The number of visible lines of text
explanation: The rows attribute is used to set the number of rows of text that will be visible without scrolling up or down.

text: Which toolbar in KompoZer is used for text formatting like bold, italic, and alignment?
explanation: The Format toolbar1 and Format toolbar2 are used to format the text, add bullets, numbering and perform similar formatting operations.

text: What happens when you click a 'Reset' button in a form?
choices: It clears all form data and sets values to default
explanation: On clicking the reset button, the values of data entered in the form are cleared and set back to default values.

text: In the 'Form Properties' dialog box, what field is mandatory to specify where data goes?
explanation: In the Action URL, enter the file name where you want the form data to be submitted.

text: Which view mode in KompoZer displays yellow markers for start tags?
explanation: The HTML Tags view... A yellow marker is used to indicate the start tag for all elements.

text: What type of file extension is used for Cascading Style Sheets?
explanation: It also supports the use of 'Styles' through Cascading Style Sheet (CSS).

text: Which tag creates a submit button in a form?
explanation: Submit: Creates a submit button... <INPUT TYPE = "submit" VALUE = "label" >.
